confirmation.sent: Check your inbox. We sent a link to {{email}} — your account can sign in once you have opened it.
confirmation.required: This account still needs its email address confirmed. Open the link we sent you, then sign in.
confirmation.resent: Another link is on its way to {{email}}.

fields.passwordHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. Nothing else is required — though an accented letter or an emoji counts for more than one.

validation.emailRequired: Enter the email address for your account.
validation.emailMalformed: An email address needs an @ with something on each side.
validation.passwordTooLong: That is past the {{max}} the server accepts. An accented letter or an emoji counts for more than one.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same. Type the new one again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Your saved circuits follow your account, on any machine.
signIn.emailDisabled: This project does not offer email and password sign-in. Use one of the methods below.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: An account is what lets a circuit outlive the tab it was built in.
signUp.confirmationWarning: We will email a confirmation link to the address you give. Signing in will not work until you have opened it — this project keeps email confirmation switched on.
signUp.closed: New accounts are closed on this deployment for the moment.
signUp.nextStep: Once the link is open, come back and sign in.
signUp.emailDisabled: This project does not offer registration by email and password. Use one of the methods below.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: We will email you a link that lets you set a new one.
reset.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link for setting a new password is on its way. It can be used once, and it expires.
reset.privacy: We answer the same way whether or not that address has an account, so this page can never be used to find out who is registered.

update.title: Set a new password
update.lead: Choose the password you will use from now on.
update.done: Your password has been changed, and you are signed in.
update.expired: This link cannot be used. Each link works once and expires soon after it is sent — ask for a fresh one.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email address and password do not match an account.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Confirm your email address first. Open the link we sent when you registered.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account already exists for that email address.
errors.EMAIL_INVALID: That does not look like an email address we can use.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: Choose a longer password, or one that mixes letters, digits and symbols.
errors.SAME_PASSWORD: That is already your password. Choose a different one.
errors.SIGN_UP_DISABLED: New accounts are closed for the moment.
errors.PROVIDER_DISABLED: That sign-in method is not available. Use your email address and password.
errors.PROVIDER_CANCELLED: That sign-in was not completed, so nothing has changed. Try again, or use your email address and password.
errors.PROVIDER_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: That account did not give us a confirmed email address. Confirm one with the provider, or sign in with an email address and password.
errors.EMAIL_SIGN_IN_DISABLED: This project does not offer email and password sign-in.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: The server would not accept that. Check what you typed and try again.
errors.LINK_EXPIRED: That link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
errors.SESSION_MISSING: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.EMAIL_SEND_LIMITED: No email could be sent just now: this project has reached its limit for outgoing messages. Try again later.
errors.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: We could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection.
errors.AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Accounts are not available on this deployment.
errors.UNKNOWN: That did not work. Try again.
